notes: Bucket total 18 (hard). Five competencies must all be satisfied in one program. C-7db66fb7 (QDP lowercase command recognition) is a hard floor and drives two rubric bands: adversarial_inputs (lowercase/mixed-case command lines, skip semantics, masked/null markers, malformed non-numeric rows) and reasoning_depth (one must infer case-insensitive keyword recognition and the depth-from-connector rule for tree listings). hidden_case_generalization is high because the verifier re-runs parse.py on three unrelated input dirs (edges: masked address, single-line address with no postal, missing pref encodings, deeper trees with special characters, lowercase QDP plus SKIP, and non-numeric rows) and compares regenerated out.tsv / tree.json / qdp.tsv byte/JSON-exactly. quantitative_correctness covers postal-code/city derivation and date normalization. tool_breadth spans JSON, pickle, base64, csv, regex, and box-drawing text.
